This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. The bulky [[humanoid]] species was distinguished by their [[Color|gray]] and pointed [[ear]]s. One member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Varkana]]<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="34 ABY">{{ResistanceDate|2|12}}</ref> commonly seen alongside another [[human]],<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> the two fleeing together when the [[First Order]] arrived.<ref name="Breakout">{{Resistance|Breakout}}</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in "[[The Missing Agent]],"<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> the twelfth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series, which aired on [[December 22]], [[2019]].<ref name="Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
